sources.title: 海淀区AI创新带城市设计竞赛官方公告
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
sources.citation: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局, 海淀区AI创新带城市设计竞赛公告, 2026-05-09.
sources.usage_note: Official announcement tasks, scope levels, key areas, language, and deliverable context.
sources.risk_note: Authoritative for competition requirements; subject to amendment by issuing authority.

sources.title: 面向智能体任务书
sources.citation: 竞赛组织方, 面向智能体任务书 (agent_taskbook.json), 2026.
sources.usage_note: Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and boundary clause.
sources.risk_note: Cleared for agent use; not a public regulatory document.

sources.title: Source Registry
sources.citation: 竞赛数据仓库, Source Registry (source_registry.json), 2026.
sources.usage_note: Public/cleared/provisional source usability registry; distinguishes formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
sources.risk_note: Registry metadata; individual source usability must be independently verified.

sources.title: Provisional Boundary Data
sources.citation: Agent-inferred provisional boundaries from OpenStreetMap and public reference data, 2026.
sources.usage_note: Submitted site boundary geometry source (provisional). Three-level scope boundaries for research, design, and key areas.
sources.risk_note: Provisional; must be replaced with official redline before statutory use.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap Contributors
sources.citation: OpenStreetMap contributors, Beijing Haidian District map data, accessed 2026-04.
sources.usage_note: Base map reference for road network, building footprints, land use patterns, and green space locations within the site boundary.
sources.risk_note: Community-maintained data; accuracy varies. Not authoritative for planning purposes.

sources.title: 海淀区统计年鉴
sources.citation: 海淀区统计局, 海淀区统计年鉴2025, 2025.
sources.usage_note: Demographic data, economic indicators, land use statistics, and population density for Haidian district context.
sources.risk_note: Official statistics; may lag behind most recent development.

sources.title: 京张铁路历史文献
sources.publisher: 中国铁道出版社 / 北京档案馆藏
sources.citation: 詹天佑纪念馆, 京张铁路百年史, 中国铁道出版社, 2006.
sources.usage_note: Historical context for Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway heritage, route alignment, station locations, and cultural significance along the AI belt corridor.
sources.risk_note: Historical interpretation; specific heritage claims require authentication by cultural heritage authorities.

sources.title: Jacquard Loom Historical Reference
sources.publisher: Musée des Arts et Métiers, Paris
sources.citation: Musée des Arts et Métiers, The Jacquard Loom: A History of Programmable Weaving, 2010.
sources.usage_note: Historical reference for the Jacquard loom as metaphor for AI-driven urban weaving; pattern-card programming as analogy for AI scenario orchestration.
sources.risk_note: Used as design metaphor; the Jacquard governance protocol is a conceptual proposal, not a historical practice.

sources.title: 中关村发展历程
sources.publisher: 中关村科技园区管理委员会
sources.citation: 中关村科技园区管理委员会, 中关村科技园区发展历程与成就, 2018.
sources.usage_note: Historical context for Zhongguancun as China's innovation heartland; informs the AI Origin Community concept and innovation ecosystem design.
sources.risk_note: Official narrative; independent economic analysis recommended for forward-looking claims.

sources.title: Global Innovation District Case Studies
sources.citation: Katz, J. & Narkar, M., The Innovation Economy in Cities and Metro Areas, Brookings Institution, 2023; plus High Line NYC, King's Cross London, 22@Barcelona, Shenzhen Bay Eco-Tech Park, Songdo Korea case studies.
sources.usage_note: Six global case studies referenced for design inspiration: High Line (NYC), King's Cross (London), 22@Barcelona (Spain), Shenzhen Bay Eco-Tech Park, Songdo (Korea), and Cambridge Innovation Cluster.
sources.risk_note: Case studies from different regulatory, cultural, and climatic contexts; direct transfer may not be appropriate.

sources.title: Site Package
sources.citation: 竞赛组织方, Site Package for AI Urban Design Competition, 2026.
sources.usage_note: Project brief, enums, allowed design space, ranges, and schemas.
sources.risk_note: Authoritative for competition format; design content is agent-generated.

sources.title: Agent Fact Pack
sources.citation: 竞赛数据仓库, Agent Fact Pack (agent_fact_pack.md), 2026.
sources.usage_note: Agent-readable navigation layer for scopes, required tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist; not a new authority source.
sources.risk_note: Processed summary; original sources take precedence.
